regime_context: The detector shows a narrowly-led tape: only 4 of 22 themes are eligible, with Banks as the sole dominant leader (score 0.998, durability 0.73, breadth 0.89) and Innovative Pharma & CXO close behind (0.988). Most of the rest of the complex is below the trend gate, and rotation signals are marked display-only with a 0.01 leader-challenger margin. Critically, gate_helps is false — on this market's history the absolute-trend gate did NOT cut drawdown — so the only validated edge is absent here and everything should carry low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) can close the margin to Banks: the condition that retires this watch is a rotation where Pharma's score exceeds Banks by more than 0.05 AND Pharma's breadth climbs above 0.75, confirming a real handoff rather than a 0.01 drift.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the confirmed leader with the highest rank, highest eligibility, highest durability (0.73), and highest breadth (0.889) among all themes — the one place where leadership concentration is unambiguous. Crowding (crowded=true, z=1.78) is a size-down caution, not a fade. However, with gate_helps false on this market, I treat the trend gate as experimental, so this is a low-conviction tilt rather than a strong call.
theses.dissent: The trend gate demonstrably does not hold in this mean-reverting market, so elevated Banks breadth/durability may simply mark the late stage of a crowded leader before a sharp shake-out — exactly the failure mode the guardrails warn against reading as a buy.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% or more before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is the only credible challenger to Banks with an extremely close score (0.988 vs 0.998 margin of 0.01) and is eligible, but its durability (0.60) and, crucially, breadth (0.643) are both lower than Banks — the move is less broadly participated. Crowding (z=1.59, crowded=true) again says size down, not buy aggressively. I lean this as a modest overweight only on the strength of the near-leader score.
theses.dissent: Lower breadth than Banks means the theme may be narrower and more fragile; with no validated gate edge in this market, the 0.01 score gap is too small to treat as a durable rotation signal and could reverse quickly.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags CSI 300 by 5% or more before the check-by date, or Banks widens its lead to more than 3 score points while Pharma's breadth drops below 0.5.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute ranks third with a positive score but is ineligible (below the trend gate) and has near-zero breadth (0.059), meaning the theme is not broadly participating even if a few names are trending. In a market where the gate does not help, an ineligible theme with no breadth is not a leadership candidate right now.
theses.dissent: AI Compute has the only 'trend' hurst_tag among the top themes, and an ineligible-but-trending theme can ignite if gate conditions change; avoiding it is not a fade, just a lack of confirmed leadership.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS turns eligible with breadth rising above 0.5 before the check-by date.
